brief:
A Palestinian youth suffered a leg wound from Israeli gunfire during a raid in the Kafr Saba neighbourhood of Qalqilya, the Quds News Network reported. The incident occurred as Israeli forces conducted operations across the occupied West Bank.

Six Palestinians were detained during the same raids, though further details on their identities and the circumstances of their arrests remain unclear.
dek: Palestinian injured, six others detained during raids in West Bank A Palestinian youth was wounded in the leg by Israeli gunfire during a raid in the Kafr Saba neighbourhood of Qalqilya in the occupied West Bank, Quds News Network reported.
title: Israeli forces wound Palestinian, detain six during West Bank raids
